scope: Proposition 8.13 (Deterministic global read-port recovery) of the manuscript “The PCP-for-PPAD conjecture: a quasilinear reduction” (preprints/The-PCP-for-PPAD-conjecture-a-quasilinear-reduction-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 136 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 a7ab4d86183890be), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 100. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: At a sufficiently small fixed balanced distance from a canonical word, every order-one logical read port can be recovered exactly in deterministic polynomial time. In particular this applies to the one-port template. No constant-query claim is made for this global decoder.
